1.sahih_international: By the fig and the olive
1.pickthall: By the fig and the olive,
1.yusuf_ali: By the Fig and the Olive,
1.shakir: I swear by the fig and the olive,
1.muhammad_sarwar: By the fig, by the olive,
1.mohsin_khan: By the fig, and the olive,
1.arberry: By the fig and the olive

3.pickthall: And by this land made safe;
3.muhammad_sarwar: and by this inviolable city, Mecca.
3.mohsin_khan: And by this city of security (Makkah).

4.sahih_international: We have certainly created man in the best of stature;
4.pickthall: Surely We created man of the best stature
4.yusuf_ali: We have indeed created man in the best of moulds,
4.shakir: Certainly We created man in the best make.
4.muhammad_sarwar: We have created the human being in the best form
4.mohsin_khan: Verily, We created man of the best stature (mould),
4.arberry: We indeed created Man in the fairest stature

5.sahih_international: Then We return him to the lowest of the low,
5.pickthall: Then we reduced him to the lowest of the low,
5.yusuf_ali: Then do We abase him (to be) the lowest of the low,-
5.shakir: Then We render him the lowest of the low.
5.muhammad_sarwar: and We shall make him the lowest of low
5.mohsin_khan: Then We reduced him to the lowest of the low,
5.arberry: then We restored him the lowest of the low --

6.sahih_international: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted.
6.pickthall: Save those who believe and do good works, and theirs is a reward unfailing.
6.yusuf_ali: Except such as believe and do righteous deeds: For they shall have a reward unfailing.
6.shakir: Except those who believe and do good, so they shall have a reward never to be cut off.
6.muhammad_sarwar: except the righteously striving believers who will have a never ending reward.
6.mohsin_khan: Save those who believe (in Islamic Monotheism) and do righteous deeds, then they shall have a reward without end (Paradise).
6.arberry: save those who believe, and do righteous deeds; they shall have a wage unfailing.

7.sahih_international: So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense?
7.pickthall: So who henceforth will give the lie to thee about the judgment?
7.yusuf_ali: Then what can, after this, contradict thee, as to the judgment (to come)?
7.shakir: Then who can give you the lie after (this) about the judgment?
7.muhammad_sarwar: After (knowing) this, what makes you still disbelieve in the Day of Judgment?
7.mohsin_khan: Then what (or who) causes you (O disbelievers) to deny the Recompense (i.e. Day of Resurrection)?
7.arberry: What then shall cry thee lies as to the Doom?

8.sahih_international: Is not Allah the most just of judges?
8.pickthall: Is not Allah the most conclusive of all judges?
8.yusuf_ali: Is not Allah the wisest of judges?
8.shakir: Is not Allah the best of the Judges?
8.muhammad_sarwar: Is God not the best of the Judges?
8.mohsin_khan: Is not Allah the Best of judges?
8.arberry: Is not God the justest of judges?
